client.industry_secondary: Women’s health services (OB/GYN, maternal-fetal medicine, telehealth)
client.business_model: Multi-state women’s health platform operating OB/GYN clinics, urgent care and telehealth services under several practice brands
client.sponsor_pe_firm: BlueMountain Capital Management (Assured Guaranty) – $45 M growth investment announced Jan 2020
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 in Arlington, Virginia, Advantia Health has grown through acquisitions (e.g., 2019 purchase of Heartland Women’s Healthcare) and now operates clinics across the Mid-Atlantic and Midwest, focusing on integrated, technology-enabled care for women.

revenue.notes: Publicly available estimators disagree: Zippia $13.0 M, Buzzfile $29.1 M, Growjo $22.4 M, CanvasBusinessModel $89 M. No official figure disclosed. Selected midpoint ($22.4 M) from Growjo; treat as directional only.

locations.notes: Manually counted distinct clinic addresses in MD (8), VA (7), IL (8), MO (1), DC (3) that are listed individually on the official locations page referenced in web search results.

employees.notes: LeadIQ reports 501 employees; SignalHire and Indeed list 500-1,000 range. Buzzfile shows 259. Majority of recent sources cluster around ~500 so 501 chosen.

extraction_sources: Agreement/Advantia Treya Procurement Cost Reduction Services Agreement (Dec 13 2021 Final) - signed.pdf
extraction_notes: Official documents consistently use the name 'Advantia Health'.
Primary industry determined from company description in web sources and project documents (women’s health clinics).
BlueMountain Capital investment noted on company press release; Deerfield also invested earlier (2016) but BlueMountain’s 2020 $45 M round appears to be current lead sponsor.
Revenue figures are third-party estimates with wide variance; no audited figures available, so confidence is low.
Locations were counted directly from addresses provided on the official website referenced in search results; count may change as network expands.
No EBITDA data found in any document or reputable web source.
